exposure: Intended parent characteristics (e.g., same-sex male couples, single men, heterosexual couples, single mothers)
Residence of intended parents (Canadian vs. non-resident)
outcome: Levels of emotional struggle at relinquishment
Frequency of thinking about surrogacy children
Surrogate-parent relationship dynamics during pregnancy and post-birth
cohort: A subgroup of 90 Canadian gestational surrogates who delivered 157 babies (105 singletons and 26 sets of twins) with a mean age of 31.7 +- 5 years at the time of surrogacy.
finding: Canadian gestational surrogates experienced little struggle with relinquishment and high rates of continued post-birth contact, particularly with same-sex male couples and single fathers, with whom they were more likely to develop long-lasting relationships.
cross-section timing: Data were collected from June 2016 to February 2017
